conventions.convention: Signature is (-,+,+,+); R(X,Y)Z = ∇X∇YZ − ∇Y∇XZ − ∇[X,Y]Z. Geometric electrovac means dF = d(⋆F) = 0 and Ric = 2Q(F), with zero cosmological constant.

MP coordinates have length units, H is dimensionless and time-independent, orientation is dx⁰∧dx¹∧dx²∧dx³, future direction is H∂₀, and Aσ = σ(H⁻¹−1)dx⁰ with σ ∈ {−1,+1}. Harmonicity is defined as ΔδH = 0; its imposition on the defined data needs clarification.

Electric and magnetic geometric fluxes are (4π)⁻¹∫S⋆F and (4π)⁻¹∫SF. Multicenter spheres have outward Euclidean orientation, positive radii, and no center on the sphere; centers remain excluded from spacetime.
Bertotti–Robinson data use L>0, dimensionless τ,z, f=z² on an open subset of z>0 or f=1+z² on an open subset of the real line, orientation dτ∧dz∧ωS², and F=−L dτ∧dz.
Null-wave data are smooth on all of R⁴, with P=−(a²+b²)(x²+y²)+h, hxx+hyy=0, orientation du∧dv∧dx∧dy, and future unit field ∂u+(P+1)∂v/2.
For positive RN mass parameter M, extremality means M²=qe²+qm². The single-center identification concerns only ρ>0 and R>m.
The near-horizon scaling uses λ>0, x⁰=T/λ and r=L+λR. Smooth local convergence concerns compact subsets of R>0 only, with no assertion across R=0.
Flat means that the Riemann tensor vanishes identically; vanishing scalar contractions alone is a different condition.

load_bearing.statement: Every datum of def-emg-xs-harmonic-mp satisfies the source-free geometric Einstein-Maxwell equations of def-emg-xs-geometric-electrovac.

Every candidate datum in def-emg-xs-null-wave is a smooth source-free geometric electrovac datum; its only nonzero Ricci component is Ricuu=2(a(u)²+b(u)²), and its Maxwell quadratic tensor has only Quu=a(u)²+b(u)² nonzero.

Every datum in def-emg-xs-br-products is a geometric electrovac datum. In the displayed local orthonormal coframe, RicAB=L⁻²diag(1,−1,1,1)AB and QAB=(2L²)⁻¹diag(1,−1,1,1)AB; all mixed base-sphere entries vanish.

For finitely many distinct centers and positive lengths mA, H=1+ΣA mA/|x−aA| is smooth, positive and harmonic on the punctured exterior, defines source-free geometric electrovac data, and has isolated-center electric flux σmA and enclosing-sphere flux σΣA mA, with magnetic flux zero.

For every defined null-wave electrovac datum, FabFᵃᵇ=S=RicabRicᵃᵇ=RabcdRᵃᵇᶜᵈ=0; the only potentially nonzero independent Riemann components are Ruiuj=−Pij/2. If a(u₀)²+b(u₀)²>0, the Riemann tensor is nonzero there.

concerns.concern: The Definition starts with arbitrary smooth positive H and says “call H harmonic when ΔδH=0,” but never explicitly requires H to be harmonic before declaring the tuple to be the positive harmonic data “for these choices.” The consuming thm-emg-xs-mp-verification claims every defined datum is electrovac and its F1 assumes ΔδH=0. On the literal unrestricted reading, H=1+ℓ⁻²|x|² is admitted and the assigned cex-emg-xs-nonharmonic-vacuum computes nonzero Maxwell and Ricci residuals. Explicitly resolve the defining restriction; the theorem's calculation is valid with harmonicity imposed.

The title “Exact electrovac plane-wave family” overclassifies the full allowed family. A plane wave in these Brinkmann coordinates has a transverse quadratic profile, whereas def-emg-xs-null-wave permits arbitrary smooth transverse harmonic h. For example, a=a₀≠0, b=0 and h=(x³−3xy²)/ℓ³ with ℓ>0 meet the hypotheses but give a nonquadratic P and transversely varying curvature Ruiuj=−Pij/2. The electrovac equations proved here remain valid for this broader family. The same plane-wave terminology occurs in emg-ms03 prose. Primary-source definition checked in Álvarez, Anero and Sánchez-Ruiz, Section 1, equations (1)–(5): [Gravitons in a gravitational plane wave](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1140/epjc/s10052-024-12986-1).
